_comment: Each removed sub-processor becomes one object here. Shape: {"id": "...", "vendor": "...", "service": "...", "effective_from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "effective_until": "YYYY-MM-DD", "removal_reason": "...", "archived_at": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The id MUST NOT be reused in subprocessors.json — once archived, the id is dead.
